one_liner: AI research notebook grounding answers and media in your uploaded sources.
access_notes: Self‑serve via Google Cloud: create a project, enable the NotebookLM Enterprise APIs, assign Gemini Notebook Enterprise licenses and required IAM roles, then obtain a user OAuth token (e.g., via gcloud). A time‑limited free trial is available. See: https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/api-notebooks and https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise/gemini-notebook?utm_source=openai
blocker_notes: Requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise licensing; while credentials and a time‑limited self‑serve trial are available, ongoing production use needs Enterprise licenses. No app review is indicated.
